Mira: quick heads-up — I rolled the canary TF change that renames the service port to `http-mtls` and wires a new secretbinding. after the apply the canary VIP started returning 502s in the gateway healthchecks. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/789
Ali: can you paste the svc + gateway snippets? might be portName vs targetPort mismatch
Mira: yep, svc snippet was `port: 8443 name: http-mtls targetPort: 8443` and gateway has a `targetRef` that expects port name `https` (we used an older convention).
Mira: terraform diff included this small change: ```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service" "inference_canary" {
  metadata { name = "inference-canary" }
  spec {
    port { name = "http-mtls" port = 8443 target_port = 8443 }
  }
}
```
Ryan: ah ok — gateway `httproute`/`tcproute` binding cares about portname mapping for SNI/probe routing. if gateway still references `https` the probe is hitting empty backend -> 502
Sam: can we patch gateway to accept numeric port instead of name as a quick rollback? or change svc back and do a proper canary?
Mira: I tried patching with `kubectl patch` but gateway controller reconciled and reverted. we can do a controlled rollback in TF or update the gateway resource in the same PR. which is less risky?
Ali: safest is to revert svc name change in TF (fast), then open a follow-up to align gateway port names. If you want to keep canary, update gateway's `rules.backendRef` port to `http-mtls` in the same PR and do a canary apply.
devops-bot: apply started for workspace=canary at 2450004905 — plan -> apply step 2/3
Mira: I pushed an immediate rollback commit to the branch (revert port name) and kicked CI -> terraform plan looks clean. will wait for canary health to stabilize, but flagged in case anyone is watching traffic.
Ryan: quick QA tip: to simulate the probe locally run `kubectl port-forward svc/inference-canary 8443:8443` then `curl -v --resolve gateway.company:443:127.0.0.1 https://gateway.company/health` — you'll see the backends.
Sam: pinging @Ali @Ryan for post-rollback follow-up: can we standardize port name mapping in the gateway module so this doesn't slip again? maybe enforce `port_name = var.port_name != "" ? var.port_name : "https"` default?
Ali: yes I'll open a module PR to make port name explicit and add a small check in the module docs.
Mira: thanks all — keeping this thread as the rollback log. will reopen PR with aligned gateway changes once infra module update lands. :thumbsup:
